crossRefs.note: As for Ishmael, I have heard you. Behold, I have blessed him, and will make him fruitful, and will multiply him…
Abraham took Ishmael his son, all who were born in his house, and all who were bought with his money: every male among…

people.name: Ishmael
people.line: Son of Abraham and Hagar; father of Arab tribes.

translations.web: These are the sons of Ishmael, and these are their names, by their villages, and by their encampments: twelve princes, according to their nations.
translations.bsb: These were the sons of Ishmael, and these were their names by their villages and encampments—twelve princes of their tribes.
translations.kjv: These are the sons of Ishmael, and these are their names, by their towns, and by their castles; twelve princes according to their nations.
translations.asv: These are the sons of Ishmael, and these are their names, by their villages, and by their encampments. Twelve princes according to their nations.
